name: Summit rat
desc: A night-active rat that licks nectar from giant pitcher lids and defecates into them; one of the most recorded mammals near the park.
about: The summit rat is a species of rodent in the family Muridae. It is found only on Mount Kinabalu and Mount Tambuyukon, Malaysia, and has been recorded at altitudes of 2,040 to 2,477 m on Mt.
